readerCopy.body: Recognizing an old pain in someone else can make stepping back feel like betrayal even when the problem cannot be fixed from outside. When Neptune opposes Chiron, compassion and sensitivity face each other directly, making another person's vulnerability easy to experience as a call to provide the rescue that was once missing elsewhere. Understanding the pain does not create control over the outcome. Care becomes more sustainable when it responds to what is actually being asked instead of trying to rewrite a previous ending through somebody else's life.
